summary: Frank Church wilderness lookout: 1930 log cabin, 1934 L-4 cab, abandoned in the 1950s; the 1930-1934 dates and a 1963 staffing item conflict.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1950s. One source says a 1930 log cabin is still there; the sources do not say the L-4 cab survives today.

staffing.status: a 1963 newspaper item names planned staff; other sources say abandoned in the 1950s

access.note: Abandoned site inside the Frank Church wilderness, reached on foot. No source describes public entry into the cabin.

visit.trail_note: Spur trail #6062 is 1.0 mile long, from the Bernard Trail and Paradise Creek Trail. Cellphone service is usually unavailable.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Salmon-Challis National Forest

events.note: First structure was a log cabin, per firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts. NHLR does not mention it.
Newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts says a man was leaving to build a lookout house at Short Creek in August 1932. The item does not say the house was finished.
L-4 cab, per NHLR, firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts.
Abandoned in the 1950s; 1950 marks the decade start only.
Frank Hutchison of Salmon manned the lookout, per a July 1951 item quoted by Forest Lookouts.
Planned staffing: Gregory Mayne of Los Angeles would be the Short Creek lookout, per a June 1963 item quoted by Forest Lookouts.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Three sources date a first log cabin to 1930. A newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts describes a lookout house being built in August 1932. NHLR, firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts date the L-4 cab to 1934. The sources do not reconcile these, so the story reports each.
NHLR, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say the cab was abandoned in the 1950s. A June 1963 item quoted by Forest Lookouts names a planned staff member for that year. The story reports both.

NHLR gives Salmon-Challis National Forest in its location line and Salmon National Forest in its description; firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts say Salmon National Forest; the Forest Service trail page is under Salmon-Challis. The story uses Salmon-Challis.

notes_for_editor: No photos added: NHLR and Idaho Fire Lookouts credit photos to the Fire Lookout Museum and Luke Channer, but the text fetched has no image URLs. The first-cabin date rests on sources that cite the same Kresek list. The 1932 item is quoted second-hand from Forest Lookouts (The Recorder Herald) and was not checked in the newspaper. Forest Service staff or history pages were not read for the staffing dates.
